{{Quote|Junker Jott: Call me Junker, everyone does. And "chief engineer" is a bit fancier than we like around here. Me and my crew just keep things running. Lights, water, atmosphere.|Junker Jott, to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|The Gangs of Mek-Sha|Mek-Sha}}</ref>}}
'''Junker Jott''' was an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who served 30 years in the Republic Navy before retiring to lead [[Junker Jott's crew|Jott's Junkers]], one of the five ruling crews on [[Mek-Sha]] in [[3627 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Engies don't get pretty views like officers. But I've seen an exciting moment or two.|Jott, to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
Junker Jott worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] for 30 years, before retiring from the service as a veteran.<ref name="Codex" /> Many of Junker Jott's friends were killed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]], leaving him with a deep dislike for the Empire, even after retiring from the Navy.<ref name="Auction">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Huttbreaker's Auction|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

After moving to Mek-Sha, Junker Jott helped overthrow the incumbent [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] rulers by programming the multitude of word [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to rebel against the Hutts. After expelling the Hutts, his [[Junker Jott's crew|crew]] became one of the leading factions on Mek-Sha, responsible for keeping the station from collapsing with his team of engineers and droids.<ref name="Codex" /> Junker Jott oversaw the assault on [[The Brothers]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers']] headquarters in the [[Brothers Oversight Center]], assisting a Republic agent to free several [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and eliminate a [[Unidentified Brothers overseer|slaver lieutenant]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Manager of Involuntary Labor|contact]] during a trade deal.<ref name="Brotherhoood Emancipation">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=heroic|Brotherhoood Emancipation|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Junker Jott liked to constantly remind fellow residents on Mek-Sha that without him, the station would fall apart at least ten times a day.<ref name="Codex" /> Jott was also deeply committed to the Republic and served as their staunchest ally on Mek-Sha. As such, he and his crew were often at odds with the slaving crew known as [[The Brothers]], who revered slavery with an almost religious zeal and were the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] largest supplier of slave labor through the exploitation and kidnap of refugees.<ref name="Brotherhoood Emancipation" />
